lessons_used: Evidence remains thin for kinds of change tested only once (e.g., adoption copy, adoption incentive, finish redesign, home new_screen); firm rules require at least 2 tests.
Redesigns ('adoption, redesign', 'choose_path, redesign', 'sign_in, redesign') consistently hurt performance, frequently resulting in early stops or negative impacts.
'home, wait_info', 'finish, new_screen', 'sign_in, hint', and 'adoption, hint' are helpful kinds of changes, each supported by winning tests.
No clear effect was consistently observed across multiple tests for 'adoption, layout', 'adoption, notification', 'choose_path, layout', 'sign_in, incentive', and 'sign_in, notification'.
Results for copy and hint changes on choose_path ('choose_path, copy', 'choose_path, hint') remain inconsistent, yielding wins alongside worse outcomes and early stops.
Predictions were regularly too high for redesigns and ineffective changes, while underpredicting the magnitude of actual winning tests.

candidates.title: Pet Desktop Control Portal Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pet desktop control screen at the end of onboarding detailing how to summon, hide, and interact with the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support mail contains multiple reports of users being confused about how to control or hide their pet after completing onboarding.

new_control_portal.headline: Mastering Your Desktop Companion
new_control_portal.body: Learn how to summon, move, and hide your pet directly from your desktop system tray.

components.text: Right-click system tray icon to hide or summon pet

guard.reason: Valid addition of a new control portal screen following the home intro step.

candidates.score_note: Proven helpful change kind (+0.1% over 13 tests) addressing support issues, though requires a new screen.

candidates.title: Engine Rendering Warmup Status Info
candidates.change: Display live status updates and estimated wait times while the rendering engine warms up on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The home waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s. Lessons show that 'home, wait_info' updates consistently aid user retention.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Rendering Engine
waiting.hint: Initial setup may take a few moments while graphic assets render.

guard.reason: Adding rendering status updates and estimated wait time to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Proven positive pattern (+1.5% over 15 tests) for mitigating long wait times on the home screen.

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Sync Persistence Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen clarifying that signing in preserves and restores previously adopted pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after logging back in. Lessons support 'sign_in, hint' changes.

sign_in.hint: Signing in automatically saves and restores all your active pets across logins.

guard.reason: Adding an informative hint about account sync persistence to the sign-in screen is compliant.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail alignment combined with high-confidence hint pattern (+2.3% over 4 tests).

candidates.title: Custom Pet Creation Photo Tips Hint
candidates.change: Show concise photo upload formatting advice directly on the upload photos screen during pet creation.
candidates.why: Support received emails about custom pet creation failing or looking incorrect, and adoption step drop-off is 33.8%. Lessons confirm 'adoption, hint' effectiveness.

upload_photos.hint: Use clear, well-lit photos with full views for best custom pet rendering results.

guard.reason: Adding helpful formatting hints to the photo upload screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop-off step (33.8%) with a proven hint strategy (+2.3% over 4 tests).

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Desktop Controls Welcome Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a new guided desktop pet control testing sub-flow screen immediately following the welcome screen.
candidates.why: Users struggle with pet commands after completing setup (3 support emails). A new flow on finish helps guide users into post-onboarding usage.

new_interactive_flow.headline: Test Your Desktop Pet Commands
new_interactive_flow.body: Practice hiding and summoning your companion before completing onboarding.

guard.reason: Adding a new interactive control testing flow after the home intro step is allowed.

candidates.score_note: New flows on finish step previously yielded negative results (-4.0%) and carry high effort.

candidates.title: Sign In Deferred Until After Adoption Journey
candidates.change: Move the sign_in step to occur after adoption certificate creation so account creation happens after pet selection.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently drops 23.5% of users before they experience pet adoption. Deferring account sign-in builds investment first.

guard.reason: screen 'sign_in' must map to an object of fields

candidates.title: Pet Companion Profile Summary Screen
candidates.change: Insert a pet summary review screen after adoption certificate confirmation to show chosen traits before waiting.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (66.2%). Adding a confirmation summary reinforces user attachment before rendering.

new_pet_summary.headline: Pet Companion Passport
new_pet_summary.body: Your companion is ready to be loaded onto your desktop environment.

guard.reason: Inserting a pet summary screen inside the onboarding flow is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops 33.8%, but adding extra screens lacks positive history and requires full release.

candidates.title: Desktop Asset Loading Checklist Indicator
candidates.change: Add a diagnostic component checklist to the waiting screen displaying real-time engine asset warmup stages.
candidates.why: Mean time in waiting screen is 2336s, causing uncertainty. 'home, wait_info' provides high visibility into loading progress.

waiting.headline: Loading Desktop Pet Assets
waiting.hint: Checking graphics renderer, desktop overlay system, and sound engine readiness.

guard.reason: Adding asset warmup checklist information to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long home step wait times using proven wait_info pattern (+1.5% across 15 tests).

candidates.title: Photo Processing Audio Visual Alert Notification
candidates.change: Add a processing status badge notification on the photo upload screen during image generation.
candidates.why: Custom pet generation can take a long time, causing users to report stalls or generation bugs (3 support emails).

upload_photos.hint: We will notify you as soon as your custom pet design is processed.

guard.reason: Adding photo processing status notification options is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption notifications have consistently hurt performance (-2.0% across 3 tests).

candidates.title: Desktop System Tray Pet Quick Hint
candidates.change: Provide a persistent hint on the final home intro screen pointing to the system tray for pet access.
candidates.why: Multiple support tickets report post-onboarding confusion regarding how to find, show, or hide the desktop pet.

home_intro.hint: Look for the pet icon in your system tray anytime to open settings or toggle pet visibility.

guard.reason: Adding a system tray navigation hint to the home intro screen is compliant.

candidates.score_note: Promising initial test (+3.4%), but evidence remains thin with only one prior test.
